author: Electronic Arts
description:
Wing Commander II continued the evolution of the franchise and pushed the boundaries for storytelling in games upon its release in 1991.

Celebrated in this special 35th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated Wing Commander community to deliver the most dynamic version ever released.

Available now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2008730/Wing_Commander_II_Vengeance_of_the_Kilrathi_35th_Anniversary_Edition
title: Wing Commander II: 35th Anniversary Edition Launch Trailer

author: Electronic Arts
description:
Road Rash, the franchise which defined the combat racing genre during the 1990s, returns in the first ever digital release of the 1996 PC version.

Celebrated in this special 30th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored to deliver a must-see experience.

Available now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448570/Road_Rash
title: Road Rash: 30th Anniversary Edition Launch Trailer

author: Electronic Arts
description:
Widely regarded as one of the most advanced PC games upon its release in 1990, Wing Commander defined the space combat genre and pushed the boundaries in terms of PC visual and audio quality.

Celebrated in this special 35th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated Wing Commander community to deliver the most dynamic version ever released.

Available now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1996640/Wing_Commander_35th_Anniversary_Edition
title: Wing Commander: 35th Anniversary Edition Launch Trailer
